preconditions.description: The piper's position is a valid index within the rats string.

preconditions.expression: all(char in 'PO~' for char in rats)
preconditions.description: The rats string contains only valid characters: 'P', 'O', or '~'.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(1 for i in range(piper_position) if rats[i] in 'O~' and rats[i+1] in 'P' or rats[i] in 'P' and rats[i+1] in 'O~')
postconditions.description: The output is the count of deaf rats, defined as rats that are moving towards the piper or in the opposite direction of the piper's movement.
